findings.statement: Finite special vertex double count. The S-channel finite special vertex F_x = -sum_m ((-1)^m/m!) {S^(1)(x), ct_m(X_a X_b)}_{H^m} of Def op-defect (iii) (and the I-channel {I, ct^(1)_{x,m}}_{H^m}, eq c10-finitesp in arity zero) is cancelled by the (Br) graphs in which an output of the bare pair cycle is joined to S^(1)(x) (resp. to a vertex of I) by the special edge: (Br, bare cycle) + (special part of -{S^(1)(x), d_delta I^CT[eps](O)}_eps) = (e^{-eps H} - 1) x (renormalised cycle) -> 0. Thm op-master (ii) lets (Br) tend to 0 while (iii) keeps F_x: the pieces are counted once on each side.
findings.evidence: (lamP,lamM) -> A_V, n = 0 (the only n = 0 field-pair row with ct_1 != 0): [eps^0] D^special_Delta = 4 lc exactly and [eps^0] D_{P_b} = [eps^0] D_{M_w} = [eps^0] D_R = 0, so Upsilon_x := [eps^0] D_x satisfies Conjecture op-pair and the independent second evaluation (C_x from the composite kernel form of CJob, lc from the arity-zero counterterm) while Upsilon + F_x misses it by exactly F_Delta = 6 H ct_1 and F_{P_b} = H d_b ct_1; with F_x Thm op-a (b) would fail on the cocycle tr(lambda lambda Z) (sum F_{P_b} = d_b H ct_1(O) != 0).
findings.consequence: All components below use Upsilon_x = [eps^0] D_x (defect cycles only); F_x is tabulated separately (tables: key F) and the pair gates are reported in both readings.

findings.statement: Strict-route family spectra (null-mode defect cycles, no use of 4 lc + C as an input): F3 twist two S' <= 6 and F4 fermion sl(2) S' <= 5 have Spec D_1 = -32 h(j) u (scalars, even j) and -32 h(j+1) u (fermions, odd j) on the sl(2) primaries, F2 su(1|1) L <= 6 has D_1 = -8 u sum(1 - Pi) as matrices; on every sector the special-edge class equals 4 lc and the line class equals the P7 (c) target, i.e. Thm op-a holds family by family as an identity between two independent evaluations.

Placements along P_b, M_w (spin part), R at the special edge cancel identically configuration by configuration (the two configurations with S^(1)(x) on either side of the special edge carry opposite Koszul signs and equal matrices since x. commutes with Q^GF and H); along these generators Upsilon_x is the line class alone, i.e. Upsilon_{P_b} = C_{P_b}, Upsilon^0_M = C^0_M and Upsilon_R = 0 pair by pair on every computed row.

The reduced pole identity [eps^-m] D^0_Delta = -4m ct_m, [eps^-m] D_{P,M,R} = 0 (scaling/covariance of the counterterm map) holds on the rows where -ct^(1)_{x,m}(sO), s ct^(1)_{x,m}(O) and the vacuum-pole x spectator terms vanish; rows with sO containing a pair with arity-one poles (e.g. (A_V, lambda), sO ⊃ (dc) lambda) need the full eq c11-pole (open).
